prose: A brief plug, via Daring Fireball, for the Inner Hive, the subscription membership that funds Ruben Bolling's Tom the Dancing Bug comic. Members get each week's strip at least a day before it appears anywhere online, plus extras like commentary, process images, bonus comics and puzzles. The post also offers a no-strings 'Friend of Tom the Dancing Bug' donation option for readers who want to support the strip without subscribing. It is a small example of the direct reader-support model sustaining independent cartoonists and writers outside of ad-driven media.
highlights: Inner Hive is a paid subscription that keeps Tom the Dancing Bug running
Members receive each week's comic at least a day before public release
Perks include exclusive commentary, process pics, extra comics, jokes and puzzles
A separate one-off donation tier ('Friend of Tom the Dancing Bug') accepts payments of any size
Illustrates direct reader funding as an alternative to ad-supported comics distribution
